text:
Cheers shift leads,
The cargo team raised a point about lounge space earlier this week

I wanted to follow up so everyone has a clear, calm approach when companion travelers arrive with pets. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is still the main contact for checks, documents, and handoff support, and our aim is to keep the process steady for guests and staff alike. When we work from the same guidance, it becomes much easier to keep arrivals moving without extra stress. Please continue to send any unusual cases our way early so we can review them before the traveler reaches the desk.

For bird bookings, <<FACT F065>>. That detail should stay with the desk process and not be relayed casually at the counter. If a traveler comes in with concerns about carrier fit, cabin placement, or comfort during the transfer, please reassure them that trained staff will handle the next step carefully and with patience. We want each animal to be treated with the same attention from check-in through handoff, and we want our service to feel dependable even when the airport is busy.

Aurelia Skyways continues to rely on the whole team to keep companion travel smooth, and your support at the lounge makes a real difference. If you notice a situation that could affect flow, comfort, or safety, please flag it at once so the right person can respond without delay. Clear communication helps us protect the traveler experience and keeps the pet journey more settled from start to finish.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
